current_official_bank_evidence.other_current_body: long straight; organizer describes track as a neutral/クセのない 400m bank

current_official_bank_evidence.renovation_note: Organizer states full bank renovation completed and reopening ceremony held 2025-05-28; current guide is therefore preferred over older historical geometry.

design_conclusion.why_not: Only one 333m venue (富山) is in this first future lock, so circumference is confounded with that venue and local program/rider mix. Two 400m venues do not remove the single-333-venue confound.
design_conclusion.allowed_interpretation: transport feasibility, missingness, source timing, and descriptive residual behavior by frozen block after a separately prespecified outcome gate
design_conclusion.forbidden_interpretation: claiming that 333m vs 400m causes or proves Rider×Circumference affinity from this three-venue pilot

next_design_gate: Before opening predictive outcomes for a generalized circumference hypothesis, prospectively lock at least one additional independent 333m venue block and preferably multiple future blocks per circumference.
Keep venue identity and physical-feature terms distinct; do not fit venue dummy rescue after seeing outcomes.
Use race-level clustered uncertainty and time-separated validation in later predictive evaluation.
Treat rider-profile '得意な周長' as official self-reported/profile attribute, not observed-performance truth; require point-in-time validity before feature use.
